design.purpose: A small desk phone rest for one phone held horizontally: the plate forms the base and the two two-brick-high end stops help keep the phone from sliding off either end.

steps.c: Place the brown 2×8 plate flat on the table.
Press the dark red 2×2 brick onto the left end.
Press the red 2×2 brick onto the right end.
Press the green 2×2 brick onto the dark red brick.
Press the orange 2×2 brick onto the red brick.
